tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt:
You recently attended a university orchestra concert.While you enjoyed the performance greatly,the sound quality at the venue was poor,making it difficult to fully appreciate the music.You would like to provide feedback to the sound engineer,Mr.Bridges,in hopes of improving future events.
Write an email to Mr.Bridges.In your email,do the following:
Write as much as you can and in complete sentences.
bullets: Describe what you enjoyed about the concert.
Explain the issue you had with the sound quality.
Suggest ways the venue could improve the sound experience for future concerts.
tasks.to: Mr.Bridges Subject:Feedback on concert sound quality
tasks.subject: Feedback on concert sound quality
tasks.sample:
Dear Mr. Bridges,



I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to provide feedback on the university orchestra concert I recently attended. Overall, I greatly enjoyed the concert, especially the rhythm of the concertos. However, the sound quality at the venue was disappointing, with loud static and crackling from the audio system disrupting the performance.



To fix this, I suggest fully testing and adjusting all audio equipment before the concert starts, including checking sound balance across different seating areas. In addition, the venue’s audio equipment can be upgraded. These would ensure that every section of the orchestra is heard clearly.



Thank you for your time to read this email, and I look forward to hearing from you.



Sincerely,

Alfonso
tasks.title: Write an Email
